# rcab business policy

<!-- Generated by `pnpm policy:doc` — do not edit by hand. `pnpm policy:doc:check` (CI lint stage) fails on drift. -->

Every business decision point of rcab in one place: fares, dispatch, the scheduled window, pool matching,
ride lifecycle, sessions, rate limits, realtime cadence, the outbox loop, and the client-side knobs.

- **Source of truth (server):** `apps/api/src/config/policy/policy.schema.ts`. The API reads the env vars below
  through it once at boot, validates every value and every cross-field rule, and refuses to start on any
  violation (the error lists every bad key, never the value). Services read the frozen `Policy` object.
- **Change a rule:** edit its `default` and `decision` in the schema (all environments) or set the env var
  (one deployment), then run `pnpm policy:doc`. "Code-fixed" knobs have no env var: change them in the schema.
- **Clients:** `apps/web/src/config/policy.ts` and `apps/driver-app/lib/core/config/policy.dart`.

67 server knobs (64 env-overridable) in 13 categories, 10 cross-field rules, 11 web and 10 driver-app knobs.

## Contents

- Pricing & fares (10)
- Dispatch (normal rides) (9)
- Scheduled booking (7)
- Shared-ride matching & pools (7)
- Ride lifecycle (3)
- Driver presence (2)
- Realtime (2)
- Sessions & auth (4)
- Idempotency (1)
- Rate limits (4)
- Outbox relay & reconciler (9)
- Observability sampling (2)
- Performance budget (load-test gates) (7)
- Cross-field rules
- Client knobs (web, driver app)

## Cross-field rules

Checked at boot after every single knob is valid.

| Rule | Env vars |
| --- | --- |
| scheduled wave 2 must start within the window (waveOneMs ≤ windowMs) | `SCHEDULED_DISPATCH_WAVE_ONE_MS`, `SCHEDULED_DISPATCH_WINDOW_MS` |
| the scheduled booking window must be non-empty (minLeadMs < maxLeadMs) | `SCHEDULED_MIN_LEAD_MS`, `SCHEDULED_MAX_LEAD_MS` |
| wave 2 widens the search (r1Meters ≤ r2Meters) | `DISPATCH_R1_METERS`, `DISPATCH_R2_METERS` |
| wave 2 must start before the hard fail (waveOneTimeoutMs < hardFailMs) | `DISPATCH_WAVE_ONE_TIMEOUT_MS`, `DISPATCH_HARD_FAIL_MS` |
| a fuller pool is never dearer per seat (seatMultiplier3 ≤ seatMultiplier2) | `SEAT_MULTIPLIER_3`, `SEAT_MULTIPLIER_2` |
| the up-front shared quote must assume a reachable pool size (sharedQuoteSeats ≤ maxSeats) | `SHARED_QUOTE_SEATS`, `MATCHING_MAX_SEATS` |
| the sweep is a seconds cron: whole seconds that divide 60 | `DRIVER_AUTO_OFFLINE_SWEEP_MS` |
| last_seen is refreshed through the geo gate, so it must be shorter than the stale cutoff | `REALTIME_GEO_INDEX_GATE_MS`, `DRIVER_STALE_AFTER_MS` |
| the p95 budget cannot exceed the p99 budget (apiP95Ms ≤ apiP99Ms) | `PERF_BUDGET_API_P95_MS`, `PERF_BUDGET_API_P99_MS` |
| an access token never outlives its refresh session (accessTokenTtlS × 1000 < refreshTokenTtlMs) | `ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_S`, `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_MS` |

## Client knobs

Server-owned values reach the clients in API responses and snapshots (quote fare, offer `ttlMs`,
pool status, ride state). The knobs below are client-side decisions; `server-mirror` rows copy a server
rule the client cannot read at runtime and must be kept in step with the table above.

### Web

`apps/web/src/config/policy.ts`

| Key | Value | Unit | Source | Description | Decision |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth.tokenRefreshMarginMs` | `30000` | ms | client | Refresh the access token this long before its exp so a request never leaves with a lapsing token. | RCAB-E8.S7 sessions remediation: 30 s skew. |
| `booking.idempotencyInProgressRetryMs` | `1000` | ms | client | Pause before the single replay of a create the API reports as still in progress (409). | RCAB-E8.S7 idempotency remediation: one replay after 1 s. |
| `booking.ratingCommentMaxLength` | `1000` | chars | server-mirror | Max rating comment length (server DTO @MaxLength(1000) re-validates). | RCAB-E4.S9 rating prompts. |
| `booking.scheduleMinLeadMs` | `900000` | ms | server-mirror | Earliest pickup the "Later" picker offers, from now (server scheduled.minLeadMs re-validates). | RCAB-E8.S14 web scheduled booking: mirrors scheduled.minLeadMs (15 min). |
| `booking.scheduleMaxLeadMs` | `86400000` | ms | server-mirror | Latest pickup the "Later" picker offers, from now (server scheduled.maxLeadMs re-validates). | RCAB-E8.S14 web scheduled booking: mirrors scheduled.maxLeadMs (24 h). |
| `booking.scheduleWakeLeadMs` | `600000` | ms | server-mirror | How long before pickup the server starts looking for a driver; until then the tracking banner says "Scheduled for ...". | RCAB-E8.S14 web scheduled booking: mirrors scheduled.wakeLeadMs (T-10 min). |
| `realtime.subscribeMaxTries` | `5` | attempts | client | Total ride/pool subscribe attempts on an `unavailable` ack (1 initial + retries). | Stage-C web fix (retry subscribe on unavailable ack). |
| `realtime.subscribeBackoffMs` | `[1000, 2000, 4000, 8000]` | ms list | client | Delay before each subscribe retry; the last entry repeats. | Stage-C web fix: 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s. |
| `realtime.reconnectDelayMaxMs` | `5000` | ms | client | Socket.IO reconnection backoff ceiling. | Code default (lib/booking/ws.ts). |
| `search.addressDebounceMs` | `400` | ms | client | Debounce between keystrokes and the Nominatim address lookup. | RCAB-E4.S1 web booking screen. |
| `search.minQueryLength` | `3` | chars | client | Shortest query sent to Nominatim (fair-use policy). | RCAB-E4.S1 web booking screen. |
